note: Each authoritative table and the only files allowed to write it. A second writer is a decision, made here, not an accident. Tables marked append-only are written by more than one file but never read back to decide anything about the world.

entities.note: every entity change goes through World.putEntity / removeEntity

inventory.note: a legacy table: the item registry is the authority and keeps it as a projection

memories_fts.note: a search index maintained by triggers

plugin_installs.note: pins: the hash and capabilities a plugin was installed with

mind_trace.note: append-only explanations; two writers for two kinds of line

life_deeds.note: what River did in this life; cleared when a new life begins

obituaries.note: the summary of each life that has ended; kept

sqlite_sequence.note: a new life restarts the id sequences

kv.note: db.ts: kvSet for settings and small values; persist.ts: committed in-memory state; reset.ts: wipe on a new life; world.ts: River's body and walk; items.ts: removes the legacy 'worn' key once
